messages.subject: Error during package deployment
parts:
I'm building a portfolio analyzer using shiny. I ran the packrat::init() command to setup the dependencies. After deploying the app I get the following error. Please help?


[2015-11-03T09:22:31.378638439+0000] Installing R package: stockPortfolio (1.2)
Error in file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) : 
  cannot open the connection
Calls: source -> file
In addition: Warning message:
In file(filename, "r", encoding = encoding) :
  cannot open file 'packrat/init.R': No such file or directory
